dct_creator_sm: Landry, Danielle (Toronto Metropolitan University). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8905-6411
dct_description_sm: We conducted a qualitative interview study (n = 10) with disabled people living in Canada who also identify across a range of social and cultural categories. Interviews explored the following research question: "How do people understand their disabilities in the context of their diverse lives across gender, sexuality, race, ethnicity and Indigeneity?". This study is part of a comparative country study involving Canada and Norway. Interview transcript data remains confidential. The study is registered with OSF: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/9M7ND
dct_title_s: Diverse Disability Identities: Gender and Sexuality, Racial and Ethnic Diversity, Indigeneity
